jobs_results.title: DevOps/SRE Engineering - Enhancing Digital Experiences
jobs_results.description:
We have a fantastic new opportunity for a DevOps/SRE Engineer to revolutionise Digital Experience Analytics!

Our SaaS platform provides deep user experience analytics for our enterprise clients, 30% of whom are part of the Fortune 100! We utilise state of the art insights and Machine Learning to enable automatic recommendations and unique improvement suggestions to increase engagement, brand growth and revenue.

We've received more than $800 Million in funding and have expanded globally, targeting a hyper-growth with close to 1,500 hires benchmarked in the coming years!

We are now building a brand new development team in Barcelona - we've already hired amazing engineers from Ocado, Adevinta, Adyen and now's your chance to join this incredibly talented team!

This is a phenomenal opportunity to work on systems of non-trivial scale and complexity and have real scope for growth as you'll be part of our technical decisions as one of the first engineers in the team in Barcelona.

Our... tech stack:

Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Prometheus, Python, Go, AWS, Azure and more!

At the heart of it, we're looking for talented Engineers from versatile backgrounds who are interested in learning new languages and tools.

Responsibilities

We are looking for talented people who are confident working across different aspects of development and are looking to step up into the next stage of their career.

We have roles in our:

Cloud Foundation Team: working on observability, monitoring, logging, networking and more.

Cloud Services Team: working on containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, infrastructure, automation tools and more.

Cloud Product Team: supporting our data and application teams and working on data streams with Kafka and our infrastructure.

Regardless of the team, our engineers have the freedom and flexibility to move between different projects. What's consistent throughout is the main challenges are on data volume, scalability issues and performance issues.

Some of the things you'd be working on include:

• Ensuring other R&D teams use Infrastructure as defined by the IaC

• Ensuring all metrics and logs are available to allow the building and relevant monitoring of dashboards by other members of the R&D

• Supervise big, cross R&D projects to improve the velocity, quality and cost of our platform

• Bridging the gap between developers and operations by closely working with other R&D teams on their projects

• Work with developers in supporting new features, services, software releases and troubleshoot problems

• Choosing the best hosting options to fit the best current needs and embrace our long-term business vision and impact the business through technology and new ideas

• Drive core-edge technologies at scale

• You will also develop skills on technologies such as: Elasticsearch, Kafka, ClickHouse, Hadoop/Spark, CDNs, DNS, Load Balancers, Monitoring, Logs, etc.

Benefits

• Competitive salary + stock options

• Hybrid working

• Working on a variety of cool projects e.g. applications with intensive data visualisations

• Exposure to the complexities of working with some of the biggest sites, apps and brands in the world

• You’ll be joining a company that has seen incredible growth and market traction

• You’ll be joining a company that truly cares about its employees and works hard to make sure your efforts are rewarded.

Want to be a part of the digital revolution?

Then what are you waiting for, click apply and let’s see what you’ve got

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer, DevOps-Spezialist/in
jobs_results.description:
ELK-Stack, Grafana, Continuous Integration, Docker,Infrastructure as Code, Istio, Kubernetes, Prometheus, IT,Deployment, Ansible, Softwareentwicklung, Continuous Deployment,On-Premise, Datenwiederherstellung, Monitoring, Jenkins, Terraform,DevOps, GitLab

DevOps Engineer (m / w / d) Digital Health

MEDIAN Unternehmenszentrale Berlin

MEDIAN is one of Europe's leadingproviders of medical rehabilitation and mental health services.With more than 120 rehabilitation centres throughout Germany,MEDIAN offers a dynamic and innovative environment for employees ina wide range of areas with a variety of job opportunities anddevelopment opportunities for applicants.

Specialising inrehabilitation and participation, we accompany our patients on theroad to recovery and back into society - in line with our guidingprinciple of "Living life".

We are looking assoon as possible for a DevOps Engineer (m / w / d) Digital Health.

Your main tasks
• Build, manage and maintain a self-hosted... Kubernetesecosystem for our services
• Lead thedevelopment and implementation of Infrastructure as Code solutionsusing tools like Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation to automatethe provisioning of infrastructure
• Establishrobust monitoring, alerting, and log management systems toproactively identify and resolve issues, ensuring high availabilityand performance
• Implement security bestpractices across the infrastructure, applications, and deploymentprocesses, including vulnerability assessments and compliancechecks
• Collaborate with cross-functionalteams, including developers and system administrators, to ensureseamless integration of DevOps practices into the softwaredevelopment lifecycle

Yourprofile
• Several years ofexperience in a DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering role,demonstrating a strong background in infrastructure and deploymentautomation
• Proficiency in Infrastructure asCode (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation
• Expertise in setting up and managing CI / CDpipelines, using tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI
• In-depth knowledge of containerizationtechnologies (Docker) and container orchestration systems(Kubernetes) and their related technologies (Docker Compose,Istio / Linkerd, Cert-Manager, etc.)
• Experience with on-premise / self-hosting
• Thorough understanding of security best practices and experienceimplementing security measures within DevOps processes
• Familiarity with monitoring and alerting tools (e.g.,Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack)
• Familiaritywith tracing tools (e.g., Jaeger, Zipkin, OpenTelemetry)
• Strong problem-solving skills and theability to troubleshoot complex issues
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills

We offer you the following benefits
• Opportunity to develop onedigital health solution from scratch and bring another to the nextlevel
• 200.000+ own patients per year waitingfor our digital health solutions
• Medicaldoctors, psychologist and therapists in 125+ MEDIAN clinicsproviding expert input
• Flat hierarchies withdirect access to MEDIAN’s top management
• Agreat team working with startup speed and mindset while benefitingfrom the established structures of one of Germany’s largest clinicgroups

Have we raised yourinterest?

Then we look forward to receiveyour comprehensive online application, stating your salaryexpectations and your possible starting date, exclusively via ourjob portal !

Mr. Max Reichel, Human Resources Manager,will be happy to answer your questions on the phone

4930 530055 239.

jobs_results.title: Devops / devsecops
jobs_results.description:
Perfil buscado (Hombre/Mujer)

The successful candidate will join as DevOps or DevSecOps assuming the following responsibilities:
• Partner with other architects, developers, and engineers to facilitate high quality delivery.
• Reflect and address key requirements and constraints of project stakeholders in architecture documentation artefacts.
• Plan architecture-related work, professionally present these plans and regularly update stakeholders on the progress.
• Analyze and improve technical and operational characteristics of existing solutions.
• Participate in prototypes building during projects´ start-up (including technology research and evaluation, if necessary) and present prototyping results and respective technical proposals.
• Support application development teams from elaboration to delivery.
• Streamlining DevOps practices in the project and organization.
• Automate and improve SDLC with a relevant suitable toolset.

• DevOps / DevSecOps - High level of English|Important... multinational technology company based in Malaga.

We are looking for a DevOps Architect who is capable to do hands-on work, has good understanding of DevSecOps culture and is ready to take responsibility for the development of cloud solutions while gong other teammates.
• 5+ years of experience in senior architecture positions.
• Experience with project delivery methodologies such as Agile Scrum or Kanban.
• Understanding of data security, information privacy and regional legislation aspects in an international enterprise.
• High level of English.

Cloud Solutions:
• Awareness and experience with Azure and /or AWS; Alibaba Cloud knowledge is considered an advantage.
• At least 2 years of experience designing, implementing and delivering enterprise cloud solutions.
• Knowledge of network topologies and firewalls.
• Reliability practices in the cloud (guaranteed delivery, high availability/clustering, backup and disaster recovery, monitoring).
• Security practices in the cloud (network perimeter defense, access control, data protection, IAM).

DevSecOps:
• Experience with automation tools like ARM Templates, Terraform, CloudFormation, Chef, Puppet or Ansible.
• Experience with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Gitlab, Jenkins, etc.
• Development or scripting experience such as bash, Powershell, etc.
• Experience with common build tools (like maven, gradle, npm, yarn, etc.).
• Knowledge and experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes, etc.).

Databases:
• Firm experience with RDMBS, NoSQL, Cloud PaaS solutions, etc.

Major technology client developing a digital platform that automates life and health insurance underwriting, focusing on biometric and lifestyle risk assessment. Enables insurance companies to adapt to changes in consumer buying behavior towards faster, more intuitive and engaging insurance shopping experiences.

• Advantage of working in a large, stable and reliable company, which managed to keep a dynamic and friendly work environment.
• Experience in international projects for first-rate global companies.
• Attractive salary and compensation package (advanced health insurance, etc.).
• Company sponsored professional trainings and certifications.
• Active/passive participation in professional international conferences.
• Hybrid telework. You will have to come to the Malaga office on time

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps engineer
jobs_results.description:
If you love working with an innovative growing American company, then this job is for you!

We are looking for a DevOps engineer that is capable of assuring that all the platform is automatized, and take care and maintain it efficiently.

First things first… top project details!

- Company/team

We are looking for a top profile to join our top team. With a team of more than 80 people who are really passionate about technology, you’ll join a groundbreaking AI healthcare related company, sounds interesting?

- Values

With headquarters in San Francisco and offices in Barcelona, you will be part of a pharma and biotech partner company that help to improve the efficiency and quality of the operations through the use of Artificial Intelligence. What are we looking for? Improving manufacturing processes to positively impact society. Our values: innovation, efficiency, collaboration, joy, respect, and commitment.

- Day to day

In your day to day you’ll be reporting to the VP of Product... Engineering, working very closely with the development team, having the strategic mindset but also involved in IT management.

- Career path

And if you are wondering… what is my career projection? Well, you will always be accompanied to grow across, horizontally or vertically, you set your limits!!

Your mission 🚀

In your day-to-day you will be implementing and managing continuous delivery systems and methodologies on AWS, defining and deploying monitoring, metrics and logging systems on AWS. Also, part of your job will be designing, managing and maintaining tools to automate operational processes. As well, you will be responsible for Infrastructure Delivery Automation processes in AWS (Infrastructure-as-a-code), and evaluation of new technologies for potential platform improvements.

Perks, my friend!

Immediate start.

Full time and permanent contract.

Competitive salary in the sector, according to your experience and skills.

Competitive healthcare plans and benefits.

Equity, bonuses and generous stock options.

Flexible schedule.

Remote working during COVID situation (When back to normality 3 days office - 2 days remote work).

Professional development and collaborative environment.

English / Spanish classes and internal training and certification plan.

Team Building Activities.

An excellent work environment with a young, dynamic collaborative team.

The possibility to join a young American company with great expectations and a huge potential to grow.

If this is you – holy cow! 🐄

Infrastructure as Code tools and Configuration Management tools.

Production experience in AWS environment.

Experience in Linux, Jenkins and Terraform.

Proficient in Written and Spoken English.

If this is also you – JACKPOT! 🍒🍒🍒

Great if you have experience with CI/CD tools.

Awesome if you already know about Code link, Bitbucket pipeline.

If you have AWS Certifications or experience in other cloud environments as Azure, GCP, would be amazing!

Python (Scripting level proficiency), Docker, Kubernetes, would be a plus.

Cool if you already know some Ansible and Packer.

If you have strong analytical skills and a business mindset, you are made for this position!

Great if you consider yourself a team player!

Good if you are a hands-on professional who takes accountability.

Commitment to quality is your motto.

Aizon focuses on Pharmaceuticals and Artificial Intelligence. Their company has offices in Barcelona. They have a mid-size team that's between 51-200 employees.

You can view their website at https://www.aizon.ai

jobs_results.title: DevOps & Infrastructure Admin
jobs_results.description:
Description

About Apex ESG Advantage

Our current economic system has brought unprecedented levels of welfare and prosperity. Yet, in many ways, this has come at a great environmental and societal cost. The time has come to forge a new path, and to transition to a more sustainable economy.

Apex ESG Advantage is one of the fastest growing ESG and sustainability firms in Europe, experiencing solid growth over the past 24 months. Our team consists of approximately 150 people from various backgrounds across Amsterdam, London, New York, Valencia and Mumbai all driven by the ambition to make a real impact.

Launched in 2021, Apex ESG Advantage is a business-to-business (b2b) software as a Service (SaaS) platform that allows companies to track their ESG performance and benchmark it against their peers and industry best practices. Specifically designed for the private equity market, it provides investors and fund managers with a holistic overview of the performance of their portfolio... companies.

The role

As a DevOps and Infrastructure Administrator, you will play a pivotal role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our cloud-based infrastructure, while ensuring seamless CI/CD pipelines and robust security practices. Our system is constantly evolving with new technologies and the job may require learning new skills and industry practices as new computing resources are adopted.

Responsibilities

• Collaborate with developers, operations teams, and security experts to identify and implement best practices for secure, reliable, and scalable cloud-based solutions.
• Implement security best practices across systems, networks, and applications to safeguard sensitive data and maintain compliance.
• Maintain documentation related to infrastructure architecture, deployment processes, and standard operating procedures.
• Proactively monitor and troubleshoot infrastructure issues, ensuring minimal downtime and quick resolution of problems.
• Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies, sharing insights and knowledge within the team.

Skills & Experience

• 2+ years in a DevOps or Infrastructure role, showcasing hands-on experience with designing and managing complex IT systems.
• Proficiency in cloud platforms (e.g. Azure) and containerization technologies (e.g. Kubernetes).
• Expertise in Git and MS DevOps, specifically in designing and managing efficient CI/CD pipelines.
• Familiarity with security protocols, compliance standards, and security assessment frameworks.
• Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive and collaborative approach.
• Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams.

Total Benefits

Our belief in promoting a healthy work-life balance drives us to support our employees total well-being, offering comprehensive benefits not limited to:

• We offer competitive pay and benefits to employees.
• Health Insurance.
• Working Schedule: Fridays reduced hours as well as August.

More About Us

We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favorable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision are made based on skills, qualifications and experiences.

We measure our success as a business, not only by delivering great products and services and continually increasing our assets under administration and market share, but also by how we positively impact people, society and the planet.

For more information on our commitment to Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) please visithttps://theapexgroup.com/csr-policy/

Click the Apply button and complete the online application process. A member of our fabulous recruiting team will then review your application and follow up with you if you seem like a great fit for this role

jobs_results.description:
Die Position

About Roche Informatics

In Roche Informatics, we build on Roche's 125-year history as one of the world's largest biotech companies, globally recognized for providing transformative innovative solutions across major disease areas. We combine human capabilities with cutting-edge technological innovations to do now what our patients need next. Our commitment to our patients' needs motivates us to deliver technology that evolves the practice of medicine.

Be part of our inclusive team at Roche Informatics, where we're driven by a shared passion for technological novelties and optimal IT solutions.

About the position

As Devops Engineer, you will join the Software Engineering & DevSecOps chapter, you will partner with other internal experts, specializing in various aspects of software engineering. Together, the team collaborates on multiple products that contribute to Roche's internal business requirements.

As Devops Engineer you will be accountable for optimizing and... automating the deployment and management of platform and cloud-based services to support application development. You will also focus on ensuring cost-effectiveness, scalability, and security in all aspects of the digital product lifecycle, including development and maintenance activities.

You are looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies.

Your key responsibilities:
• Collaborating with architects and developers to establish technical specifications.
• Have good understanding on product strategy, business requirements and translating them development tasks and when required lead DevSecOps activities
• Driving the implementation and maintenance of efficient Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery pipelines to automate the software delivery process.
• Deploying and managing the software application underlying infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code principles and tools and maintaining version-controlled configurations.
• Implementing robust security practices throughout the development and deployment lifecycle and solutions to measure the availability and performance of software applications.
• Developing and maintaining technical specifications, diagrams and supporting system documentation

Your qualifications and experience:

The following skills are a must for the job:
• Experience in full software development lifecycle from requirements gathering, design, software development, testing and retirement of systems
• Experience with agile software development methodologies
• Experience with source code management tools (Gitlab, Github and/or Bitbucket)
• Experience with CI/CD Pipelining (Gitlab-ci, Github actions and/orJenkins).
• Experience in mainstream programming languages (Java, Python)
• Experience with observability and monitoring tools (i,eDataDog, Splunk, LogicMonitor, Elastic Search, Grafana, etc)
• Experience with containers and/or Kubernetes.

Additionally, as a nice to have:
• Experience with hardening infrastructure
• Experience with one of the following Public cloud providers: AWS, Azure or GCP.
• Experience in developing and using validated systems.

Education / Years of Experience:
• 3 – 5 Years of relevant work experience with Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering or 5 – 7 Years of relevant work experience
• At least 3+ years experience of working in one or more multinational work environments (e.g. healthcare industry experience is a plus).

What you get:
• Dynamic and collaborative team environment
• Global influence and impact
• Vibrant and enjoyable workplace culture
• Career advancemen
• Many other benefits and opportunities for growth
• And many more that the Talent Acquisition Partner will be happy to talk about!

Wer wir sind

Bei Roche leisten 100,000 Menschen in 100 Ländern Pionierarbeit im Gesundheitswesen. Gemeinsam haben wir uns zu einem weltweit führenden, forschungsorientierten Healthcare-Konzern entwickelt. Unser Erfolg baut auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt.

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert

jobs_results.title: Senior Cloud/Devops Architect (Azure)
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

Why are we here?

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.
Job Description

In a nutshell

As a Senior Cloud Architect at Eurofins you will be supporting our global IT Application development teams to move towards a cloud-first and DevOps mind-set and transition... many of our applications to be deployed, run and operated via automation in the public cloud.

Where will you be based and what business will you support?

Based in Dublin, Ireland, you will be part of a geographically dispersed IT Architecture team with a focus on supporting our global IT Application development teams.

How can you help us?

As a Senior Cloud Architect in Eurofins you will:
• Collaborate with the Cloud Engineering Team in defining cloud Standards and Governance;
• Design scalable enterprise cloud frameworks (AWS control Tower, Azure Landing Zones etc);
• Collaborate with product development to define their technology transition into the cloud;
• Evangelise DevOps/Cloud culture and practices throughout the business;
• Define and standardise tooling;
• Improve software performance metrics;
• Be a trusted hands-on advisor for IaC and CI/CD pipelines;
• Automation of processes, testing and security;
• Document standards in readiness for governance approval;
• Consult with business to build new channels between development and operations teams.
Qualifications

Are you our kind of extraordinary?

You have:
• At least 5 years of experience in Cloud architecture (Azure); including high-level designs, cloud governance and related technical documentation;
• Strong general experience in both Multi Cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) and On-premises environments.
• Hands on experience with Terraform and Cloudformation;
• Hands on experience of Kubernetes and containerisation;
• Knowledge of DevOps tooling
• Collaboration tools.
• Application Lifecycle Management tools,
• Cloud/IaaS/PaaS/Serverless tools,
• Source and version control tools,
• CI/CD delivery tools,
• Continuous testing/security testing tools,
• Release Orchestration tools,
• Monitoring tools,
• Analytics tools;
• Experience with CI/CD and GitOps pipelines;
• The ability to manage multiple projects / tasks concurrently and drive them to completion;
• The ability to work independently and effectively under pressure while identifying ambiguity and driving for clarity;
• The ability to motivate and influence others;

You are:
• An excellent communicator (concise writing and orally convincing)
• A strong collaborator, able to build relationships with both leaders and team members.
• Capable to establish trust based on outstanding expertise with stakeholders
• Capable of adapting quickly to a complex distributed organization
• Detail oriented

What else should I know?
• Experience in working with distributed teams or offshore teams is a plus.
• Vendor Specific cloud certifications, Architect, DevOps are also a plus!
Additional Information

What can we offer you?
• A competitive salary package, including bonus and benefits;
• Extensive on-the-job coaching and training opportunities;
• A hybrid working environment (office/home)
• Challenges within a multi-cultural and cross-regional team as part of the international and fast-growing Eurofins organization;
• A dynamic working environment with a good team spirit where personal development and growth are highly encouraged.

Your application:

As the role and Eurofins' IT Talent Acquisition team are international, please ensure to submit your application in English.

Want to know more about us?

We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity! Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Sustainability matters to us! We are well on our way to achieving our objective of carbon neutrality by 2025, through a combination of emission reduction and compensation initiatives. We encourage our laboratory leaders to make sustainable changes at their local level, and in addition to their initiatives we also count on our dedicated carbon reduction team to help us to achieve this goal!

Find out more in our career page: https://careers.eurofins.com/

Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 62,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of ca. 900 laboratories in 61 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2022, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.7 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years

jobs_results.title: DevOps Release Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

SQLI Group is a digital agency, with 30 years leading the implementation and management of digital devices for a reinvented user experience. We are over 2500 talents in more than 13 countries and 3 continents. We are a human touch company & key partner of the largest international companies with global projects.

We #Perceive #Challenge #Deliver #Inspire

Job Description

We are looking for an expert of Software Development Lifecycle to fulfil all tasks and duties as a Senior DevOps Release Engineer . He/she will review the whole DevOps set up for a global eCommerce platform application. This is within an international project for one of the top 3 food & beverage companies in the world.

What is this all about?

The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the software release process, ensuring the quality of the software, and implementing DevOps practices to improve software development efficiency.
• He/she will assess the lifecycle of this eCommerce... platform applications, identifying requirements, DevOps tools & platforms and automation gaps to ensure an agile & DevSecOps ways of working.
• This person will also coordinate all the teams working on the definition and automation of the desired solutions for eCommerce applications, ensuring that the high-level priorities set by the project/program manager are properly mapped to the day-to-day tasks, and following up on the quality of the deliverables.
• He/she will also participate in the adoption of the new software development lifecycle, finding the right balance for the introduction in an ongoing release cycle delivery for eCommerce applications.
• Monitor and report on system health and performance metrics, and proactively identify and resolve issues.
• Continuously improve the DevOps process through research and experimentation with new tools, technologies, and methodologies

Qualifications

Who are you?
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in software development, with at least 2 years in a DevOps or release role.
• Deep understanding about software development lifecycle, who can consolidate (and challenge) the needs of requestors, developers, testers, platform and system engineers, and support teams, identifying gaps and dependencies.
• Experience with continuous integration and continuous deployment tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or CircleCI.
• Sound knowledge of Jenkins, and Ansible. Experience with containerization and container orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
• Familiarity with cloud infrastructure platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

Additional Information

What do we offer?
• Permanent contract.
• Competitive salary.
• Flexible Remuneration (Meal vouchers, kinder garden, Public Transport/Mobility)
• Private health insurance (including dental care).
• Juno Journey Premium member platform with a lot of on-line learnings (certifications, courses, etc).
• Individual yearly training and certification budget.
• Onsite/Hybrid policy work.
• Work Schedule Monday to Friday.
• Intensive working hours on Fridays and all week in July and August.
• Full salary coverage for sick leave.
• Relocation package.

Data protection notice

SQLI Group ensures that applicants' personal data is processed as required by the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Ley de Protección de Datos 3/2018 of the Spanish Kingdom . Personal data is processed for the purpose of carrying out the hiring process and joining to our talent community. You can exercise your rights in terms of General Data Protection and digital guarantees through dataprotection.spain@sqli.com
